# Bundled browser dependencies

These are unmodified files from the official npm packages:

- Three.js 0.186.1, MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- urdf-loader 0.13.1, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/gkjohnson/urdf-loaders

Only the modules needed by the viewer and their imports are included. Each
package has its license beside the source. `versions.json` records the exact
registry URLs and archive SHA-256 checksums. These files are dependencies, not
application code; the application lives one directory above.
